entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. My name is Ashley. How can I help you today?

Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working out for me. It's constantly disconnecting from my phone and the heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate.
I understand your frustration. I can definitely help you with a return. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. I see your order here, including the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return policy is 90 days for a full refund, provided the item is in good condition. Are all the original accessories included?
Yes, everything's in the box. Look, I need this taken care of quickly. I don't have all day to argue about a stupid smart watch.
I apologize for any inconvenience, sir. I can process the return for you right now. Just to confirm, the VeloBand Pulse is in its original packaging with all accessories, and in good condition?
Yes, yes, yes! Just get it done!

Okay, perfect. I've processed the return. You should receive a prepaid shipping label via email within the next hour. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days.
Finally! Okay, thanks. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome! Thank you for choosing VeloFit. Have a great day!
